content.intro: {state} charges {stateRate} sales tax on a vehicle, a flat title fee and a yearly registration fee. Your town also bills a yearly excise tax based on the vehicle's original price.

howItWorks.text: The sales tax rate is {stateRate} of the purchase price. When a vehicle is traded toward another vehicle, the tax is figured only on the difference.
Your town collects the excise tax at the town office when you register. For a new vehicle it is based on the manufacturer's suggested retail price.

faq.q: Does a trade-in lower the sales tax in Maine?
faq.text: Yes, when you trade one motor vehicle toward another, tax is figured on the difference. A trade of another kind of item does not lower it.
